about_the_game:
Taste the arrangements for each era and platform!
Includes six home port versions of titles from Operation Night Strikers.
From the 8-bit machines of the 1980s to the CD-ROM expansion devices for 16-bit machines of the early 1990s, you can enjoy games arranged to suit different environments from the arcades.

Lineup
  • Operation Wolf (FC/NES/SEGA Master System version)
  • Operation Thunderbolt (SNES version)
  • Night Striker (Mega CD version)
  • Space Gun (SEGA Master System version )

Operation Wolf
Includes the FC version released in Japan in 1989, the NES version released in North America and elsewhere, and the SEGA Master System version released in Europe and elsewhere.
The game is set in the South American country of Lychego, where the former president and embassy staff have been imprisoned due to a coup d'état.
There are numerous features that have influenced later gunshots, such as the use of different firearms depending on the situation, firefights while protecting hostages, and enemies attacking from behind cover.

Operation Thunderbolt
contains the SNES version released in North America in 1994.
Six soldiers, including “Dan Burnett” and “Shin Miyamoto,” throw themselves into the battlefield to rescue passengers and others on a passenger jet hijacked by soldiers of the Republic of Bintaj.
There are several elements original to the home version, including a selectable stage at the beginning of the game.

Night Striker
Contains the Mega CD version released in 1993.
The United Nations Special Action Force, known as the “Night Striker,” drives through the night streets in their armored car, the “Intergray,” to crush the ambitions of terrorists.
The background music can be switched to a version arranged uniquely for this title.

Space Gun
Includes the SEGA Master System version released in 1992.
The setting is the space exploration era of 2039. A space marine commando pursuing an unexplained accident confronts a terrifying monster inside a space freighter that sends out a distress signal.

Quick save and load to try again and again!
Save and load at any time. You can play your favorite scenes over and over again, practice difficult situations to hone your skills, and enjoy the game more deeply.

name: Operation Night Strikers CS Pack
short_description: Taito's 80's arcade hits hit back on console! Six console versions of the 80s arcade movement in one action-packed compilation!
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
*languages with full audio support
